alt: Cracker Barrel Old Country Store restaurant exterior in Bloomsburg, Pennsylvania, showing the original red sign, rocking chairs on the porch, and barrels by the entrance — the nostalgic branding management tried and failed to replace.
story: Cracker Barrel CEO Julie Masino unveiled a minimalist wordmark in August 2025, dumping the beloved 'Uncle Herschel' rocking-chair logo; the stock lost $100M in one day, Trump tweeted, and the logo was reversed in six days — then Masino stepped down July 27, 2026, telling Glenn Beck: 'I feel like I've been fired by America.'
why_funny: The CEO hired to modernize America's most aggressively un-modern restaurant chain outlasted her rebrand by exactly one year before being un-modernized herself.
